result.instructions: Tools for Sellasist, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders from the last 7 days are still unpaid?"; "Show me order 12345 with its items and tracking number."; "Which products have fewer than 5 units in stock?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sellasist data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sellasist_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sellasist_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sellasist_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. sellasist_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sellasist_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first, with status, buyer billing address, payment, total, source (Allegro, eBay, Amazon, shop...) and comment. Filter by status, email, name, external id, payment, source or date. Use sellasist_get_order for line items and shipments. GET /orders.

email_contains.description: Buyer email starting with this text.

first_name.description: Buyer first name (billing address, LIKE match).

last_name.description: Buyer last name (billing address, LIKE match).

external_id.description: The order id in the shop or marketplace it was imported from.

exact_date.description: Orders placed on exactly this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_from.description: Orders placed at or after this date.

date_to.description: Orders placed at or before this date.

from_id.description: Only orders with an id greater than this.

sort.description: Sort by id, default desc (newest first).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id: status, buyer and delivery address, payment, shipment method, line items (product ids, EAN, quantities, prices), notes, waybills with tracking numbers, payments and additional fields. GET /orders/{order_id}.

order_id.description: Sellasist order id (the id from sellasist_list_orders, not the marketplace's number).

tools.name: sellasist_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders by creation date and status
tools.description: Find up to 100 orders created in a date range and/or in one status (id, date, status). Read-only: it uses POST only because the criteria go in the body. POST /orders_search.

creation_date_from.description: Created at or after this date.

creation_date_to.description: Created at or before this date.

order_id_from.description: Start from this order id (for the next batch, pass the last id returned).

tools.name: sellasist_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: The order statuses configured in the account. Use the ids to filter orders or to change a status. GET /statuses.

tools.name: sellasist_list_order_notes
tools.title: List order notes
tools.description: Notes written on one order (author id, date, text, visibility). GET /notes/{order_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_order_logs
tools.title: List order change log
tools.description: The audit log of order actions (create, edit, status change, delete, merge, invoice and receipt actions) with date and user id. Filter by order ids, action type or date. GET /orders_logs.

date_from.description: Actions at or after this date.

date_to.description: Actions at or before this date.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_list_waybills
tools.title: List waybills (shipping labels)
tools.description: Waybills (shipping labels) with order id, tracking number, creation and delivery date. Filter by order or date. Label files are not returned inline. GET /ordersshipments.

date_from.description: Created at or after this date.

date_to.description: Created at or before this date.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products with id, name, EAN, symbol, catalog number, location, price, promo price, stock quantity, reserved quantity and variants. Filter by category, manufacturer, EAN, symbol or catalog number. GET /products.

category_id.description: Category id, or several separated by commas - see sellasist_list_categories.

auction_id.description: Offer id in an external marketplace (Allegro, shop...).

from_id.description: Only products with an id greater than this.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id: title, category, prices, VAT, stock, sold counts, EAN, symbol, location, weight, qualities, availability, manufacturer and more. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_get_stock
tools.title: Get stock levels
tools.description: Stock quantity of one product, found by id, EAN, symbol or catalog number (the first one given in that order counts); with none of them, a page of stock levels for all products. GET /products_stock.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_list_bestsellers
tools.title: List bestselling products
tools.description: Products ranked by units sold in the last month (sold_last_month), with stock and price. GET /products_bestsellers.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: sellasist_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: Product categories. GET /categories.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_get_category
tools.title: Get category
tools.description: One category: names per language, parent category and status. GET /categories/{category_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: Warehouses (id, title). Needs the warehouse-management feature, otherwise Sellasist answers HTTP 406. GET /storages.

tools.name: sellasist_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Registered customers (the account's buyers). GET /users.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer: email, registration date, billing and delivery address. GET /users/{user_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Invoices (id, number, date). Filter by order, document series or issue date. GET /invoices.

date_from.description: Issued at or after this date.

date_to.description: Issued at or before this date.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice: number, dates, seller, buyer, currency, line items (net, gross, VAT), total and paid amount. GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: Return documents (RMZ): number, status, source, linked order, refund value and tracking number. Filter by date, order, status, source or return number. GET /returns.

date_from.description: Created at or after this date.

date_to.description: Created at or before this date.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: sellasist_get_return
tools.title: Get return
tools.description: One return document with status, refund and payment details, tracking, courier and the returned items. GET /returns/{id}.

tools.name: sellasist_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: Payment methods (id, title) for filtering orders. GET /payments.

tools.name: sellasist_list_shipment_methods
tools.title: List delivery methods
tools.description: Delivery methods (id, title) for filtering orders. GET /shipments.

tools.name: sellasist_list_order_sources
tools.title: List order sources
tools.description: Order sources available in the account (id, name, type: Allegro, shop, marketplace...). GET /sources.

tools.name: sellasist_list_integration_accounts
tools.title: List connected marketplace accounts
tools.description: Accounts connected in external services (id, login, type). Only these three fields are returned. GET /external_accounts.

tools.name: sellasist_list_alerts
tools.title: List system alerts
tools.description: Active alerts and system messages shown on the Sellasist dashboard (type, severity, title, message). GET /alerts.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: sellasist_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add a new note to an order. Notes are visible to the account's staff; each call adds another note (nothing is overwritten). POST /notes.

tools.name: sellasist_update_order_status
tools.title: Change order status
tools.description: WRITE: change the status of one order (PUT /orders/{order_id} with only the status). Sellasist may run the status's automations (emails, stock moves). By default the new status is NOT pushed to the marketplace; set send_status_to_external to true to push it. Find status ids with sellasist_list_order_statuses.

send_status_to_external.description: Also send the new status to the external marketplace or shop the order came from.

prompts.title: Get started with Sellasist
prompts.description: What you can do with Sellasist here, with example requests to try.
